items.label: Daily Loss Limit
items.detail: No daily loss cap. Focus shifts entirely to End-of-Day trailing drawdown management.

items.label: Max Drawdown
items.detail: 50k:$2,000 | 100k:$3,000 | 150k:$6,000. Trails at EOD. Locks at Starting Balance + $100 post-first payout.

items.label: Consistency Rule
items.detail: No single day's profit may exceed 30% of cycle total. Continue trading until ratio normalizes.

items.label: Guardian Shield
items.detail: Auto-closes all positions if floating loss hits 2% of starting balance. Prevents catastrophic DD.

items.label: News Trading
items.detail: ±5 min Red Folder ban. Clear orders ±2 min for all news. Adhere strictly to entry criteria during volatility.

items.label: CME Price Limit
items.detail: Prohibited to trade within 2% of CME settlement limit. Monitor % Net Change on quote board.

items.label: Risk/Reward & Stops
items.detail: Initial SL required. Stop trailing to lock gains allowed. Widening stops or gambling behavior triggers review.

items.label: Automation & Scalping
items.detail: No AI/bots. >200 trades/day & microscalping banned. Martingale allowed within margin & contract limits.

items.label: Trading Hours
items.detail: System auto-closes at 16:10 EST. No breach penalty. Weekend holds permitted.

items.label: Profit Split
items.detail: 100% of first $15,000. 90% thereafter. Processed ≤48h via RiseWorks Mon-Fri before 3PM CST.

items.label: Frequency & Conditions
items.detail: Requires 10 net-positive trading days. Min $500 per request. No fixed calendar day; rolling cycle.

items.label: Payout Targets
items.detail: 1st: 6% of start balance. 2nd+: 4%. Resets upon request. Consistency must be met per cycle.

items.label: Payout Caps
items.detail: 50k:$1,000 | 100k:$2,000 | 150k:$3,000. Designed to scale with proven consistency.

items.label: Available Balances
items.detail: Activation fee $149 charged ONLY upon passing eval. Eval reset: 30% off within 7 days of fail.

items.label: Max Position Size
items.detail: 50k:5M/50μ | 100k:10M/100μ | 150k:15M/150μ. No scaling restrictions, but overleveraging monitored.

items.label: Max Accounts
items.detail: Sim + Live combined max 3. Additional accounts require ongoing eval subscriptions.

items.label: KYC & Compliance
items.detail: Full Veriff verification (PoI, PoA, AML) required before fund release. One verified profile per trader.
